name: S. V. J. Enterprises Limited
summary: S. V. J. Enterprises Limited operates as a healthy lifestyle company in India. The company is involved in the manufacturing, buying, supplying, importing, exporting and selling like fox nut, disposal, food, and grain products. It also engages in manufacturing, trading, and selling silver paper plates. S. V. J. Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Mumbai, India.
